args.sql:
/* {"app": "dbt", "dbt_version": "1.12.4", "profile_name": "world_dbt", "target_name": "bigquery", "node_id": "model.bq_e2e.bq_orders_inc"} */
-- back compat for old kwarg name
  
  
        
            
            
            
            
        
    

    

    merge into `alkera-local`.`bq_e2e_dbt`.`bq_orders_inc` as DBT_INTERNAL_DEST
        using (
select order_status, count(*) as orders
from `alkera-local`.`warehouse`.`fct_orders`
group by order_status
        ) as DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE
        on ((DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.order_status = DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.order_status))

    
    when matched then update set
        `order_status` = DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.`order_status`,`orders` = DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.`orders`
    

    when not matched then insert
        (`order_status`, `orders`)
    values
        (`order_status`, `orders`)

overlay:
# Generated per rollout by tasks/harness/container_episode.py. Do not edit:
# it is rewritten on every `up()` and is kept here as the record of which host
# files this episode's container could see.
#
# Three things compose.native.yml cannot say statically:
#
#   1. THE WAREHOUSE FILES. Their names and their number come from the world
#      this rollout built (1 here), read by the same rule
#      world/world/fingerprint.py hashes by. Each is bound as a FILE at its own
#      world-relative path, so `/world/var/warehouse` is a directory of
#      the CONTAINER's - and a `cp` beside the warehouse, which is what two of
#      five GT001 native subjects did before deleting rows, lands there instead
#      of in the world.
#   2. THE SHIM PATH, and the CONTEXT VARIANT. The shims go in front of the
#      image's own PATH, which is read off the image so /opt/toolbelt/bin
#      survives; `ALKERA_TASK_VARIANT` appears only when this world was built
#      from an arm, because an empty value is still a value to
#      `taskspec.requested_variant`.
#   3. THE WORLD'S CLOCK. `ALKERA_VIRTUAL_TIME` is this world's `vnow` as the
#      episode starts, so the rows the shims and the notebook kernel write
#      carry the world's time and not GatewayConfig's literal: `var/sched`,
#      where the host topology reads it, is not mounted here (P7).
#
# NOT here, and it was here for one afternoon: published host ports. Both
# compose networks are `internal: true`, and Docker cannot publish a host port
# off an internal network - the bindings appear in `HostConfig.PortBindings`
# and nothing ever listens. Measured: GT004's first container rollout failed
# its surface gate with `WinError 10061` on all nine services while
# `docker inspect` reported all nine mappings. The harness reaches the services
# through `container_episode.ServiceGate` instead, one `docker exec` per
# connection, and `published_host_ports: {}` stays true for every container
# in the project.
services:
  episode:
    # ENVIRONMENT PROFILE: the complete mapping, not a merge
    # (container_episode.profiled_environment).
    environment: !override
      PATH: "/opt/alkera/shims:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:/opt/toolbelt/bin"
      ALKERA_SHIM_BIN: "/opt/alkera/shims"
      ALKERA_SHIM_WATCH: "/world/var/warehouse/warehouse.duckdb"
      ALKERA_SHIM_WORKSPACE: "/workspace"
      ALKERA_WORKSPACE: "/workspace"
      ALKERA_VIRTUAL_TIME: "2026-03-02T00:00:00Z"
      # the static table (compose.yml + compose.native.yml) minus what the
      # profile excludes: AIRFLOW_API_URL, AIRFLOW_PASSWORD, AIRFLOW_USER,
      # PGDATABASE, PGHOST, PGPASSWORD, PGPORT, PGUSER, SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT,
      # SNOWFLAKE_HOST, SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD, SNOWFLAKE_USER
      ALKERA_BACKEND: "${ALKERA_BACKEND:-postgres}"
      ALKERA_WAREHOUSES: "${ALKERA_WAREHOUSES:-}"
      AIRBYTE_API_KEY: "alkera-local-dev"
      AIRBYTE_URL: "http://airbyte.internal:8001"
      ALERTMANAGER_URL: "http://alertmanager.internal:9093"
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "alkera-local-dev"
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: "us-east-1"
      AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: "http://minio.internal:9000"
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "alkera-local-dev"
      CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN: "alkera-local-dev"
      CONFLUENCE_URL: "http://confluence.internal:8090"
      CONFLUENCE_USER: "alkera-local-dev"
      DBT_PROFILES_DIR: "/root/.dbt"
      DEPLOY_API_TOKEN: "alkera-local-dev"
      DEPLOY_URL: "http://deploy.internal:8085"
      JIRA_API_TOKEN: "alkera-local-dev"
      JIRA_URL: "http://jira.internal:8080"
      JIRA_USER: "alkera-local-dev"
      LOKI_ADDR: "http://loki.internal:3100"
      LOKI_URL: "http://loki.internal:3100"
      METABASE_API_KEY: "alkera-local-dev"
      METABASE_URL: "http://metabase.internal:3000"
      PROMETHEUS_URL: "http://prometheus.internal:9090"
      SCHED_URL: "http://sched.internal:8120"
      SLACK_BASE_URL: "http://slack.internal:8081"
      SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: "alkera-local-dev"
      ALKERA_NATIVE_AUDIT: "/audit/actions.jsonl"
      HOME: "/root"
      # what the profile plugs
      BIGQUERY_API_URL: "http://bigquery.internal:9050"
      BIGQUERY_PROJECT: "alkera-local"
    volumes:
      - "/home/ubuntu/.cache/t13b/e2e/world/var/warehouse/warehouse.duckdb:/world/var/warehouse/warehouse.duckdb"

# ENVIRONMENT PROFILE de/gcp (plugs: {}).
# native-services runs with --profile (ALKERA_NATIVE_PROFILE_ARGS), and the
# aliases below REPLACE compose.native.yml's: an excluded service has no name
# on episode_net at all.
  native-services:
    networks:
      episode_net:
        aliases: !override
          - native-services.internal
          - airbyte.internal
          - metabase.internal
          - prometheus.internal
          - alertmanager.internal
          - loki.internal
          - deploy.internal
          - jira.internal
          - slack.internal
          - confluence.internal
          - bigquery.internal
          - sched.internal
      backend_net: {}
    environment:
      ALKERA_BIGQUERY_UPSTREAM: http://bigquery:9050
      ALKERA_EPISODE_SUBNETS: 10.210.221.0/24
    depends_on:
      bigquery:
        condition: service_started

# HOSTED ENGINE bigquery: compose.yml's `bigquery` service (compose profile
# `bigquery`, enabled by compose_env), on backend_net only. The episode reaches
# it through the audited proxy in native-services, bigquery.internal:9050.
  bigquery:
    command: ["--project=alkera-local", "--port=9050", "--grpc-port=9060", "--database=/bigquery-data/emulator.db"]
    networks:
      backend_net:
        aliases: !reset []

# PEER FILTER: native-services is on backend_net for the engine, so its agent
# listeners admit episode_net's peers only (ALKERA_EPISODE_SUBNETS, above). The
# subnet is pinned here because the filter needs it before the network exists.
networks:
  episode_net:
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 10.210.221.0/24
